headlines.name: How COP31 became climate diplomacy’s ‘darkest moment’
headlines.headline: How COP31 became climate diplomacy’s ‘darkest moment’
headlines.description: No one expected the 31st Conference of the Parties to be game-changing — from the start, everyone called it an “implementation” COP — but those gathered in Antalya, Turkey, hoped it would at least maintain momentum on clean energy development. They also wanted to see countries reaffirm their commitment to multilateral climate action amid heightened geopolitical tension.

headlines.description: In 2002 Gwynne Shotwell had a lunch that would change her life—and the trajectory of the business world as we know it. headlines.description: The Trump administration on Monday added the company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, Megaspeed, to a trade blacklist designed to prevent it from obtaining US-made semiconductors. headlines.name: Mississippi's election fights didn't end with Scott Colom's historic Senate win
headlines.headline: Mississippi's election fights didn't end with Scott Colom's historic Senate win
headlines.description: Mississippi is facing two fights over its election rules after Democrat Scott Colom 's historic Senate victory: one over voters marked inactive and another over deadlines for receiving mail-in ballots . Why it matters: The disputes could affect how easily eligible voters cast ballots and which mail ballots count when Mississippi elects a new governor and other statewide leaders next year.

sources.title: Mississippi’s outlier election laws face new scrutiny after tight U.S. Senate race
